metadata.name: Contour Land Map
metadata.description: Contur Land is a full-screen landing page hero for a land and regional mapping company based in Denver, Colorado. A live, animated topographic contour map fills the background and rises toward the cursor, while a coordinate readout shows latitude, longitude, and elevation
